purpose: Audit of cue/trial-phase confounds in the V7 rest-vs-intent contrast
evaluation_rows: development_observed participants (V7 roles), recordings after recording 0

original.description: V7 windows: cue-period intent vs post-task rest, zero-phase filters

precue_rest.description: Same intent windows; rest taken from the 2 s before the cue

precue_rest_late_intent.description: Pre-cue rest; intent window moved 1 s later to avoid cue-evoked responses

precue_rest_late_intent_causal.description: Strictest: pre-cue rest, late intent window, causal filters

rest_vs_rest_control.description: Negative control: post-task rest (scored as 'positive') vs pre-cue rest. Neither contains motor imagery; separability measures trial-phase signal.
